premises.name: QFORM-RANK3-ALL-RESIDUAL-ORIENTATIONS-v1
premises.scope: exact-rank-three original-coordinate principal block with nonzero scalar pivot; arbitrary induced affine terms and outside couplings

premises.name: full-matrix indefinite-pair theorem
premises.scope: s_3(A)>=s and an invertible indefinite original-coordinate physical pair; arbitrary affine terms

premises.name: QFORM-PARABOLIC-CONDITIONAL-CAP-INSUFFICIENT-v1 plus exact null-graph identity
premises.scope: exact trace identity for 2ZW+V^2 and obstruction to replacing product provenance by marginal/conditional caps

new_result.statement: If one three-original-coordinate principal block C has sigma_min(C)>=s>0, then the full ambient quadratic form has an essentially bounded density with norm at most 128*2^(1/4)/s <153/s, for arbitrary cap-one independent inputs and arbitrary outside coefficients/couplings.
new_result.mechanism: Condition outside the physical triple. If a diagonal pivot is >=s/2 use rank-three half-Riesz consequence; otherwise singular-value nonsingularity forces an off-diagonal >=sqrt(3/8)s, producing an indefinite pair with |det|>s^2/8 and sigma_min>((sqrt(6)-2)/4)s, then use the full-matrix pair theorem.

partner_application: For canonical T=2ZW+V^2 with independent cap-one Z,V,W, partner identity N(h)=2||p_T||_infinity and the new localized theorem give N(h)<=256; partner obstruction proves these caps do not extend to arbitrary non-product h.
unresolved_implication: QFORM-INDEFINITE-AGGREGATE-BEFORE-INVERSION-v1: under only three large spectral eigenvalues, aggregate original-coordinate packets before reciprocal-minor payment and force either a universally paid localized grouped block or a diffuse/ridge/many-small-pair branch, preserving product provenance.
next_step: Attack the no-good-triple branch by a determinant/compound-matrix mass decomposition coupled to the existing ridge/diffuse and many-small-pair mechanisms; do not use marginal or conditional caps alone.
